title: Hanuman Chalisa
edition_note: Traditional text as commonly printed (Gita Press style Awadhi spellings).

verses.hindi: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मन मुकुर सुधारि। बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि॥
verses.telugu: శ్రీ గురు చరణ సరోజ రజ, నిజ మన ముకురు సుధారి। బరనఉం రఘుబర బిమల జసు జో దాయకు ఫల చారి॥
verses.english_transliteration: Shri guru charan saroj raj, nij man mukur sudhari. Baranau Raghubar bimal jasu jo dayaku phal chari.
verses.meaning_english: We clean our hearts like a mirror and praise Lord Rama, who gives the four blessings of life.
verses.meaning_telugu: మనసును శుభ్రం చేసి, నాలుగు మంగళాలు ఇచ్చే రాముని కీర్తన చేస్తాము.
verses.why_special_english: This verse teaches us to begin with respect and a clean heart.
verses.why_special_telugu: గౌరవంతో, శుభ్రమైన hrudayam tho modalu pettadam nerchutam.

arrange_lines: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मन मुकुर सुधारि।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Knowing we are small, we remember Hanuman and ask for strength, wisdom, and a peaceful heart.
Victory to Hanuman, an ocean of wisdom and goodness! His light shines in all three worlds.

verses.hindi: बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवन-कुमार। बल बुद्धि विद्या देहु मोहि हरहु कलेस बिकार॥
verses.telugu: బుద్ధిహీన తను జానికే, సుమిరౌం పవన-కుమార। బల బుద్ధి విద్యా దేహు మోహి, హరహు కలేస వికార॥
verses.english_transliteration: Buddhihin tanu janike, sumirau Pavan-kumar. Bal buddhi vidya dehu mohi, harahu kalesh vikar.
verses.meaning_english: Knowing we are small, we remember Hanuman and ask for strength, wisdom, and a peaceful heart.
verses.meaning_telugu: మనం చిన్నదని తెలుసుకొని హనుమంతుని గుర్తు చేసుకొని బలం, బుద్ధి, శాంతి అడుగుతాము.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman helps us when we feel we need more strength and wisdom.
verses.why_special_telugu: Bala, buddhi kavali anipinchinappudu Hanuman sahayam.

arrange_lines: बल बुद्धि विद्या देहु मोहि हरहु कलेस बिकार॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Victory to Hanuman, an ocean of wisdom and goodness! His light shines in all three worlds.
Hanuman is Rama's messenger and has amazing strength. He is Anjani's son, called the son of the wind.

verses.hindi: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुण सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥
verses.telugu: జయ హనుమాన్ జ్ఞాన గుణ సాగర। జయ కపీస్ తిహुం లోక ఉజాగర॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jai Hanuman gyan gun sagar. Jai Kapis tihun lok ujagar.
verses.meaning_english: Victory to Hanuman, an ocean of wisdom and goodness! His light shines in all three worlds.
verses.meaning_telugu: జ్ఞానమూ మంచి గుణాల ocean లా ఉన్న హనుమంతునికి జయ! అతని light మూడు లోకాల్లో కాంతి.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman's goodness is as deep as an ocean of learning.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman is Rama's messenger and has amazing strength. He is Anjani's son, called the son of the wind.
Brave Hanuman is strong like thunder. He keeps bad thoughts away and stays with good thoughts.

verses.hindi: रामदूत अतुलित बल धामा। अंजनि-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा॥
verses.telugu: రామదూత అతులిత బల ధామా। అంజని-పుత్ర పవనసుత నామా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Ramdoot atulit bal dhama. Anjani-putra Pavan-sut nama.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman is Rama's messenger and has amazing strength. He is Anjani's son, called the son of the wind.
verses.meaning_telugu: హనుమంతుడు రాముని దూత, అసాధారణ బలం కలవాడు. అంజనాదేవి కుమారుడు, పవనపుత్రుడు.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman carries Rama's message with great courage.

wrong_meanings_en: Brave Hanuman is strong like thunder. He keeps bad thoughts away and stays with good thoughts.
Hanuman shines like gold and looks beautiful, with earrings and curly hair.

verses.hindi: महाबीर बिक्रम बजरंगी। कुमति निवार सुमति के संगी॥
verses.telugu: మహావీర బిక్రమ బజరంగి। కుమతి నివార సుమతి కే సంగి॥
verses.english_transliteration: Mahavir bikram Bajrangi. Kumati nivar sumati ke sangi.
verses.meaning_english: Brave Hanuman is strong like thunder. He keeps bad thoughts away and stays with good thoughts.
verses.meaning_telugu: వీరుడైన హనుమంతుడు బజరంగి లా బలమైనవాడు. చెడు ఆలోచనలు తొలగించి మంచితనంతో ఉంటాడు.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman is strong and chooses good thoughts.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman shines like gold and looks beautiful, with earrings and curly hair.
He holds a thunderbolt and a flag. A sacred thread rests on his shoulder.

verses.hindi: कंचन बरन बिराज सुबेसा। कानन कुण्डल कुंचित केसा॥
verses.telugu: కంచన బరన బిరాజ సుబేసా। కానన కుండల కుంచిత కేసా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Kanchan baran biraj subesa. Kanan kundal kunchit kesa.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman shines like gold and looks beautiful, with earrings and curly hair.
verses.meaning_telugu: బంగారు వంటి రంగులో అందంగా కనిపిస్తాడు, కుండలాలు మరియు గిరగిరా జుట్టు ఉంటాయి.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman's bright form reminds us of courage and beauty.

wrong_meanings_en: He holds a thunderbolt and a flag. A sacred thread rests on his shoulder.
He is dear like a son of Kesari and is worshipped for his bright courage all over the world.

verses.hindi: हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै। काँधे मूँज जनेऊ साजै॥
verses.telugu: హాథ వజ్ర ఔ ధ్వజా బిరాజై। కాంధే మూఁజ జనేఊ సాజై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Hath vajra au dhvaja birajai. Kandhe munj janeu sajai.
verses.meaning_english: He holds a thunderbolt and a flag. A sacred thread rests on his shoulder.
verses.meaning_telugu: చేతిలో వజ్రాయుధం, ధ్వజం. భుజంపై పవిత్ర జనెఊ.
verses.why_special_english: His symbols show he protects dharma with power and faith.

wrong_meanings_en: He is dear like a son of Kesari and is worshipped for his bright courage all over the world.
Hanuman is wise and skilled. He is always eager to help Lord Rama.

verses.hindi: शंकर सुवन केसरी नंदन। तेज प्रताप महा जग बंदन॥
verses.telugu: శంకర సువన కేసరి నందన। తేజ ప్రతాప మహా జగ బందన॥
verses.english_transliteration: Shankar suvan Kesari nandan. Tej pratap maha jag bandan.
verses.meaning_english: He is dear like a son of Kesari and is worshipped for his bright courage all over the world.
verses.meaning_telugu: కేసరి కుమారuday లా ప్రకాశవంతమైన ధైర్యానికి ప్రపంచం namaskaram చేస్తుంది.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman is loved like a brave and shining hero.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman is wise and skilled. He is always eager to help Lord Rama.
He loves to hear Rama's stories. Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita live in his heart.

verses.hindi: बिद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर। राम काज करिबे को आतुर॥
verses.telugu: విద్యావాన్ గుణి అతి చాతुर। రామ కాజ కరిబే కో ఆతుర॥
verses.english_transliteration: Vidyavan guni ati chatur. Ram kaj karibe ko aatur.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman is wise and skilled. He is always eager to help Lord Rama.
verses.meaning_telugu: హనుమంతుడు తెలివైనవాడు. రామuni panulu cheyadaniki eppudu utsaham.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman uses his skills to serve Rama.

wrong_meanings_en: He loves to hear Rama's stories. Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita live in his heart.
He became tiny to meet Sita and became huge to burn Lanka.

verses.hindi: प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया। राम लखन सीता मन बसिया॥
verses.telugu: ప్రభు చరిత్ర సునిబే కో రసియా। రామ లఖన సీతా మన బసియా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Prabhu charitra sunibe ko rasiya. Ram Lakhan Sita man basiya.
verses.meaning_english: He loves to hear Rama's stories. Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita live in his heart.
verses.meaning_telugu: రామuni kathalu vinadaniki ishtam. Rama, Lakshmana, Sita atani hrudayamlo untaru.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman keeps Rama's family in his heart always.

wrong_meanings_en: He became tiny to meet Sita and became huge to burn Lanka.
In a mighty form he protected Rama's work and stopped cruel demons.

verses.hindi: सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा। बिकट रूप धरि लंक जरावा॥
verses.telugu: సూక్ష్మ రూప ధరి సియహిందిఖావా। వికట రూప ధరి లంక జరావా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sukshma roop dhari Siyahi dikhava. Vikat roop dhari Lanka jarava.
verses.meaning_english: He became tiny to meet Sita and became huge to burn Lanka.
verses.meaning_telugu: Sita to kalavadaniki chinna roopam, Lanka daggaraki velladaniki pedda roopam.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman can be gentle or mighty as needed.

wrong_meanings_en: In a mighty form he protected Rama's work and stopped cruel demons.
He brought the life-saving herb and helped Lakshmana live again. Rama's heart filled with joy.

verses.hindi: भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे। रामचन्द्र के काज सँवारे॥
verses.telugu: భీమ రూప ధరి అసుర సँహారే। రామచంద్ర కే కాజ సँవారే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Bhim roop dhari asur sanhare. Ramchandra ke kaj sanvare.
verses.meaning_english: In a mighty form he protected Rama's work and stopped cruel demons.
verses.meaning_telugu: Bheem roopamlo rakshasulni odinchadu, Rama panini kapadadu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman uses strength to help, not to hurt innocents.

wrong_meanings_en: He brought the life-saving herb and helped Lakshmana live again. Rama's heart filled with joy.
Lord Rama praised Hanuman greatly and said he is as dear as brother Bharata.

verses.hindi: लाय सजीवन लखन जियाए। श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये॥
verses.telugu: లాయ సజీవన్ లఖన్ జియాఏ। శ్రీరఘుబీర హరషి ఉర లాయే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Lay sajeevan Lakhan jiyaye. Shri Raghuvir harashi ur laye.
verses.meaning_english: He brought the life-saving herb and helped Lakshmana live again. Rama's heart filled with joy.
verses.meaning_telugu: Sanjeevani tecchi Lakshmanuni brathiki chesadu. Rama hrudayam santosham tho nindindi.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman saved a friend and made Rama happy.

wrong_meanings_en: Lord Rama praised Hanuman greatly and said he is as dear as brother Bharata.
Rama hugged Hanuman when even a thousand mouths could not finish praising him.

verses.hindi: रघुपति कीन्ही बहुत बड़ाई। तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई॥
verses.telugu: రఘుపతి కీన్హీ బహుత బడ़ाई। తుమ మమ ప్రియ భరతహి సమ భాఈ॥
verses.english_transliteration: Raghupati kinhi bahut badai. Tum mam priya Bharat-hi sam bhai.
verses.meaning_english: Lord Rama praised Hanuman greatly and said he is as dear as brother Bharata.
verses.meaning_telugu: Rama Hanuman ni mikkili prema tho prasamsincharu, Bharata laga priyamaina sodarudu ani annaru.
verses.why_special_english: Rama showed that true love can be like family.

arrange_lines: तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Rama hugged Hanuman when even a thousand mouths could not finish praising him.
Great sages like Sanaka and Narada know Hanuman's glory.

verses.hindi: सहस बदन तुम्हरो जस गावैं। अस कहि श्रीपति कण्ठ लगावैं॥
verses.telugu: సహస బదన తుమ్హరో జస గావైं। అస కహి శ్రీపతి కంఠ లగావైं॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sahas badan tumharo jas gavai. As kahi Shripati kanth lagavai.
verses.meaning_english: Rama hugged Hanuman when even a thousand mouths could not finish praising him.
verses.meaning_telugu: Vela mukhalu kuda sariponantha stuti chesina, Rama Hanuman ni hug chesadu.
verses.why_special_english: Even words are not enough to praise Hanuman's love.

wrong_meanings_en: Great sages like Sanaka and Narada know Hanuman's glory.
Even gods of wealth and direction, and wise poets, cannot fully describe his praise.

verses.hindi: सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा। नारद सारद सहित अहीसा॥
verses.telugu: సనకాదిక బ్రహ్మాది మునీసా। నారద సారద సహిత అహీసా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sanakadik Brahmadi munisa. Narad Sarad sahit ahisa.
verses.meaning_english: Great sages like Sanaka and Narada know Hanuman's glory.
verses.meaning_telugu: Sanaka munulu, Narada lanti pedda munulu Hanuman mahima telusu.
verses.why_special_english: Wise people everywhere honor Hanuman.

wrong_meanings_en: Even gods of wealth and direction, and wise poets, cannot fully describe his praise.
Hanuman helped Sugriva meet Rama and receive the kingdom.

verses.hindi: जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते। कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते॥
verses.telugu: జమ కుబేర దిగపాల జహాఁ తే। కబి కోబిద కహి సకే కహాఁ తే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jam Kuber Digpal jahan te. Kabi kobid kahi sake kahan te.
verses.meaning_english: Even gods of wealth and direction, and wise poets, cannot fully describe his praise.
verses.meaning_telugu: Dhanadhipulu, dikpalakulu, kavi kobidulu kuda polina stuti cheyaleru.
verses.why_special_english: No one can fully count Hanuman's gifts.

arrange_lines: कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman helped Sugriva meet Rama and receive the kingdom.
Vibhishana followed Hanuman's advice and became king of Lanka.

verses.hindi: तुम्हरो उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा। राम मिलाय राज पद दीन्हा॥
verses.telugu: తుమ్హరో ఉపకార సుగ్రీవహింకీన్హా। రామ మిలాయ రాజ పద దీన్హా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Tumhro upkar Sugrivahin kinha. Ram milay raj pad dinha.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman helped Sugriva meet Rama and receive the kingdom.
verses.meaning_telugu: Sugrivuni Rama tho kalipinchi rajyam ivvadaniki Hanuman sahayam chesadu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman helps friends find what is right.

wrong_meanings_en: Vibhishana followed Hanuman's advice and became king of Lanka.
Hanuman leaped across the sky as if the sun were a sweet fruit far away.

verses.hindi: तुम्हरो मंत्र बिभीषण माना। लंकेस्वर भए सब जग जाना॥
verses.telugu: తుమ్హరో మంత్ర విభీషణ మానా। లంకేశ్వర భయే సబ జగ జానా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Tumharo mantra Vibhishan mana. Lankeshwar bhae sab jag jana.
verses.meaning_english: Vibhishana followed Hanuman's advice and became king of Lanka.
verses.meaning_telugu: Vibhishanudu Hanuman upadesam vinadu, Lanka adhipati ayadu.
verses.why_special_english: Good advice from Hanuman can change a kingdom.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman leaped across the sky as if the sun were a sweet fruit far away.
With Rama's ring in his mouth, he crossed the ocean—what a wonder!

verses.hindi: जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानु। लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू॥
verses.telugu: జుగ సహస్ర యోజన పర భాను। లీల్యో తాహి మధుర ఫల జానూ॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jug sahasra yojan par Bhanu. Leelyo tahi madhur phal janu.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman leaped across the sky as if the sun were a sweet fruit far away.
verses.meaning_telugu: Suryuni dooram unna madhura phalam laga kanipinchi samudram daatinadu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman's leap shows faith can cross any distance.

wrong_meanings_en: With Rama's ring in his mouth, he crossed the ocean—what a wonder!
Hard tasks in the world become easier with Hanuman's kind help.

verses.hindi: प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं। जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं॥
verses.telugu: ప్రభు ముద్రికా మేలి ముఖ మాహీं। జలధి లాఁఘి గయే అచరజ నాహీं॥
verses.english_transliteration: Prabhu mudrika meli mukh mahin. Jaladhi langhi gaye achraj nahin.
verses.meaning_english: With Rama's ring in his mouth, he crossed the ocean—what a wonder!
verses.meaning_telugu: Rama mudrika notlo pettukoni samudram daatinadu—adbhutam!
verses.why_special_english: With Rama's sign, Hanuman crossed the scary ocean.

wrong_meanings_en: Hard tasks in the world become easier with Hanuman's kind help.
Hanuman guards Rama's door. No one enters without permission.

verses.hindi: दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते। सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते॥
verses.telugu: దుర్గమ కాజ జగత కే జేతే। సుగమ అనుగ్రహ తుమ్హరే తేతే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Durgam kaj jagat ke jete. Sugam anugrah tumhare tete.
verses.meaning_english: Hard tasks in the world become easier with Hanuman's kind help.
verses.meaning_telugu: Kastamaina panulu Hanuman anugraham tho suluvugavutayi.
verses.why_special_english: With Hanuman's help, hard jobs feel possible.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman guards Rama's door. No one enters without permission.
In Hanuman's care we find comfort. He protects us so we need not be afraid.

verses.hindi: राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे। होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे॥
verses.telugu: రామ దుఆరే తుమ రఖవారే। హోత న ఆజ్ఞా బిను పైసారే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Ram duare tum rakhvare. Hot na agya binu paisare.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman guards Rama's door. No one enters without permission.
verses.meaning_telugu: Hanuman Rama dwaram kapadutadu, ajna lekunda evaru raaru.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman guards what is sacred.

wrong_meanings_en: In Hanuman's care we find comfort. He protects us so we need not be afraid.
Hanuman can calm his own power, yet his roar can make the three worlds tremble.

verses.hindi: सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना। तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना॥
verses.telugu: సబ సుఖ లహై తుమ్హారీ సరణా। తుమ రచ్ఛక కాహూ కో డర నా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sab sukh lahai tumhari sarna. Tum rachchak kahu ko dar na.
verses.meaning_english: In Hanuman's care we find comfort. He protects us so we need not be afraid.
verses.meaning_telugu: Hanuman saranalo santosham, bhayam ledu—atadu rakshakudu.
verses.why_special_english: We are safe to learn when Hanuman protects us.

arrange_lines: तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman can calm his own power, yet his roar can make the three worlds tremble.
Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when brave Hanuman's name is chanted.

verses.hindi: आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै। तीनों लोक हाँक ते काँपै॥
verses.telugu: ఆపన తేజ సమ్హారో ఆపై। తీనోం లోక హాఁక తే కాఁపై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Apan tej samharo apai. Teeno lok hak te kanpai.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman can calm his own power, yet his roar can make the three worlds tremble.
verses.meaning_telugu: Tanaku tana tejasu control, kani tana garjanalo moodu lokalu venutayi.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman is powerful yet caring.

wrong_meanings_en: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when brave Hanuman's name is chanted.
Sickness and pain go away when we lovingly remember brave Hanuman.

verses.hindi: भूत पिशाच निकट नहिं आवै। महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै॥
verses.telugu: భూత పిశాచ నికట నహింఆవై। మహావీర జబ నామ సునావై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Bhoot pishach nikat nahin avai. Mahavir jab nam sunavai.
verses.meaning_english: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when brave Hanuman's name is chanted.
verses.meaning_telugu: Hanuman peru vinnapudu bhootalu daggaraki raavu.
verses.why_special_english: Chanting his name keeps fear away.

wrong_meanings_en: Sickness and pain go away when we lovingly remember brave Hanuman.
Hanuman frees us from trouble when we remember him in thought, word, and heart.

verses.hindi: नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा। जपत निरंतर हनुमत बीरा॥
verses.telugu: నాసై రోగ హరై సబ పీరా। జపత్ నిరంతర హనుమత్ బీరా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Nasai rog harai sab peera. Japat nirantar Hanumat bira.
verses.meaning_english: Sickness and pain go away when we lovingly remember brave Hanuman.
verses.meaning_telugu: Rogalu, vedana Hanuman gurtu tho poyipotayi.
verses.why_special_english: Remembering Hanuman can comfort us when we are unwell.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman frees us from trouble when we remember him in thought, word, and heart.
Rama is the king of saints, and Hanuman arranges all his work.

verses.hindi: संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै। मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै॥
verses.telugu: సంకట తేం హనుమాన్ ఛుడ़ావై। మన క్రమ వచన ధ్యాన జో లావై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sankat te Hanuman chhudavai. Man kram vachan dhyan jo lavai.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman frees us from trouble when we remember him in thought, word, and heart.
verses.meaning_telugu: Manasa, vacha, karma tho gurtu chesukunte Hanuman sankatam nundi vidipistadu.
verses.why_special_english: Thinking of Hanuman in three ways brings freedom from worry.

arrange_lines: मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Rama is the king of saints, and Hanuman arranges all his work.
Whatever wish we bring with faith can bring endless good fruit in life.

verses.hindi: सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा। तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा॥
verses.telugu: సబ పర రామ తపస్వీ రాజా। తిన కే కాజ సకల తుమ సాజా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sab par Ram tapasvi raja. Tin ke kaj sakal tum saja.
verses.meaning_english: Rama is the king of saints, and Hanuman arranges all his work.
verses.meaning_telugu: Tapasvi raju Rama, a panulu anni Hanuman chesadu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman happily does Rama's good work.

arrange_lines: तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा॥।
wrong_meanings_en: Whatever wish we bring with faith can bring endless good fruit in life.
Hanuman's glory is famous in all four ages and lights up the world.

verses.hindi: और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै। सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै॥
verses.telugu: ఔర మనోరథ జో కోఈ లావై। సోఈ అమిత జీవన ఫల పావై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Aur manorath jo koi lavai. Soi amit jivan phal pavai.
verses.meaning_english: Whatever wish we bring with faith can bring endless good fruit in life.
verses.meaning_telugu: Manasulo unna korika nammakam tho techina phalalu vastayi.
verses.why_special_english: Faith with Hanuman can bring beautiful results.

wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman's glory is famous in all four ages and lights up the world.
He protects good saints and is Rama's beloved destroyer of cruelty.

verses.hindi: चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा। है प्रसिद्ध जगत उजियारा॥
verses.telugu: చారోం జుగ పరతాప తుమ్హారా। హై ప్రసిద్ధ జగత ఉజియారా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Charon jug partap tumhara. Hai prasiddh jagat ujiyara.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman's glory is famous in all four ages and lights up the world.
verses.meaning_telugu: Nalugu yugalalo Hanuman tejasu prasiddhi, prapancham veligindi.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman's light has helped people for a very long time.

wrong_meanings_en: He protects good saints and is Rama's beloved destroyer of cruelty.
Mother Sita gave Hanuman the blessing to grant spiritual gifts and treasures.

verses.hindi: साधु-संत के तुम रखवारे। असुर-निकंदन राम दुलारे॥
verses.telugu: సాధు-సంత కే తుమ రఖవారే। అసుర-నికందన రామ దులారే॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sadhu-sant ke tum rakhvare. Asur-nikandan Ram dulare.
verses.meaning_english: He protects good saints and is Rama's beloved destroyer of cruelty.
verses.meaning_telugu: Sadhuvulni kapadutadu, Rama priyudu, asurulanu odinchutadu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman stands with good people.

wrong_meanings_en: Mother Sita gave Hanuman the blessing to grant spiritual gifts and treasures.
Hanuman keeps Rama's holy name close and always serves Lord Rama.

verses.hindi: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता। अस बर दीन जानकी माता॥
verses.telugu: అష్ట సిద్ధి నౌ నిధి కే దాతా। అస బర దీన జానకీ మాతా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Asht siddhi nau nidhi ke data. As bar deen Janaki mata.
verses.meaning_english: Mother Sita gave Hanuman the blessing to grant spiritual gifts and treasures.
verses.meaning_telugu: Janaki talli Hanuman ki ashtasiddhi, nava nidhi vrata icharu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman shares blessings with a humble heart.

arrange_lines: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता।
wrong_meanings_en: Hanuman keeps Rama's holy name close and always serves Lord Rama.
By loving Hanuman we find Rama and forget sorrows from many births.

verses.hindi: राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा। सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा॥
verses.telugu: రామ రసాయన తుమ్హరే పాసా। సదా రహో రఘుపతి కే దాసా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Ram rasayan tumhare pasa. Sada raho Raghupati ke dasa.
verses.meaning_english: Hanuman keeps Rama's holy name close and always serves Lord Rama.
verses.meaning_telugu: Rama rasayanam Hanuman daggar, sada Rama dasudu.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman always stays Rama's loving servant.

wrong_meanings_en: By loving Hanuman we find Rama and forget sorrows from many births.
At life's end we reach Rama's home and are known as Hari's devotees.

verses.hindi: तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै। जनम-जनम के दुख बिसरावै॥
verses.telugu: తుమ్హరే భజన రామ కో పావై। జనమ-జనమ కే దుఖ బిసరావై॥
verses.english_transliteration: Tumhare bhajan Ram ko pavai. Janam-janam ke dukh bisravai.
verses.meaning_english: By loving Hanuman we find Rama and forget sorrows from many births.
verses.meaning_telugu: Hanuman bhakti tho Rama labhistaru, janma janma dukhale maripoyayi.
verses.why_special_english: Loving Hanuman helps us feel close to Rama.

wrong_meanings_en: At life's end we reach Rama's home and are known as Hari's devotees.
If we do not chase other gods, Hanuman alone brings every happiness.

verses.hindi: अंत काल रघुबर पुर जाई। जहाँ जन्म हरि-भक्त कहाई॥
verses.telugu: అంత కాల రఘుబర పుర జాఈ। జహాఁ జన్మ హరి-భక్త కహాఈ॥
verses.english_transliteration: Ant kaal Raghupati pur jai. Jahan janm Hari-bhakt kahai.
verses.meaning_english: At life's end we reach Rama's home and are known as Hari's devotees.
verses.meaning_telugu: Chivari samayam Rama nagaram, Hari bhakta peru vastundi.
verses.why_special_english: Hanuman guides devotees home to Rama.

wrong_meanings_en: If we do not chase other gods, Hanuman alone brings every happiness.
Troubles and pains melt for those who remember strong Hanuman.

verses.hindi: और देवता चित्त न धरई। हनुमत सेइ सर्व सुख करई॥
verses.telugu: ఔర దేవతా చిత్త న ధరఈ। హనుమత్ సేఇ సర్వ సుఖ కరఈ॥
verses.english_transliteration: Aur devta chitt na dharai. Hanumat sei sarv sukh karai.
verses.meaning_english: If we do not chase other gods, Hanuman alone brings every happiness.
verses.meaning_telugu: Itara devatala venuka Hanuman chalu—sarvam mangalam.
verses.why_special_english: Trusting Hanuman brings peaceful joy.

wrong_meanings_en: Troubles and pains melt for those who remember strong Hanuman.
Glory, glory, glory to Hanuman! Please bless us like a kind teacher.

verses.hindi: संकट कटै मिटै सब पीरा। जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा॥
verses.telugu: సంకట కటై మిటై సబ పీరా। జో సుమిరై హనుమత్ బలబీరా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Sankat kate mite sab peera. Jo sumirai Hanumat balbira.
verses.meaning_english: Troubles and pains melt for those who remember strong Hanuman.
verses.meaning_telugu: Balavantudaina Hanuman gurtu tho sankatam, vedana poyipotayi.
verses.why_special_english: Strong remembrance of Hanuman removes troubles.

wrong_meanings_en: Glory, glory, glory to Hanuman! Please bless us like a kind teacher.
Whoever reads this ten times finds great joy and freedom from bondage.

verses.hindi: जै जै जै हनुमान गोसाईं। कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं॥
verses.telugu: జై జై జై హనుమాన్ గోసాఈं। కృపా కరహు గురుదేవ కీ నాఈं॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jai Jai Jai Hanuman Gosai. Kripa karahu gurudev ki nai.
verses.meaning_english: Glory, glory, glory to Hanuman! Please bless us like a kind teacher.
verses.meaning_telugu: Jai Jai Jai Hanuman! Guruvu laga krupa cheyyandi.
verses.why_special_english: We cheer for Hanuman with happy hearts.

wrong_meanings_en: Whoever reads this ten times finds great joy and freedom from bondage.
Whoever reads Hanuman Chalisa gains success—Lord Shiva is the witness.

verses.hindi: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई। छूटहि बंदि महा सुख होई॥
verses.telugu: జో సత బార పాఠ కర కోఈ। ఛూటహి బంది మహా సుఖ హోఈ॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jo sat bar path kar koi. Chhutahi bandi maha sukh hoi.
verses.meaning_english: Whoever reads this ten times finds great joy and freedom from bondage.
verses.meaning_telugu: Padasaarlu chadivite bandham nundi vimukti, pedda santosham.
verses.why_special_english: Practice can bring freedom and joy.

arrange_lines: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई।
wrong_meanings_en: Whoever reads Hanuman Chalisa gains success—Lord Shiva is the witness.
Tulsidas always serves Hari and asks Hanuman to live in his heart.

verses.hindi: जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चालीसा। होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा॥
verses.telugu: జో యహ పఢ़ై హనుమాన్ చాలీసా। హోయ సిద్ధి సాఖీ గౌరీసా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Jo yah padhai Hanuman Chalisa. Hoy siddhi sakhi Gaurisa.
verses.meaning_english: Whoever reads Hanuman Chalisa gains success—Lord Shiva is the witness.
verses.meaning_telugu: Hanuman Chalisa chadivite siddhi—Gaurisa sakshi.
verses.why_special_english: Reading with love brings success in good deeds.

wrong_meanings_en: Tulsidas always serves Hari and asks Hanuman to live in his heart.
Son of the wind, remover of trouble, auspicious form—please live in our hearts with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.

verses.hindi: तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा। कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा॥
verses.telugu: తులసీదాస్ సదా హరి చేరా। కీజై నాథ హృదయ మహँ డేరా॥
verses.english_transliteration: Tulsidas sada Hari chera. Kijai Nath hridaya mahin dera.
verses.meaning_english: Tulsidas always serves Hari and asks Hanuman to live in his heart.
verses.meaning_telugu: Tulsidas sada Hari dasudu, Hanuman hrudayamlo undamani korutadu.
verses.why_special_english: We invite Hanuman to live inside our hearts.

wrong_meanings_en: Son of the wind, remover of trouble, auspicious form—please live in our hearts with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.

verses.hindi: पवनतनय संकट हरन, मंगल मूरति रूप। राम लखन सीता सहित, हृदय बसहु सुर भूप॥
verses.telugu: పవనతనయ సంకట హరన, మంగళ మూరతి రూప। రామ లఖన సీతా సహిత, హృదయ బసహు సుర భూప॥
verses.english_transliteration: Pavan tanay sankat haran, mangal murti roop. Ram Lakhan Sita sahit, hriday basahu sur bhoop.
verses.meaning_english: Son of the wind, remover of trouble, auspicious form—please live in our hearts with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.
verses.meaning_telugu: Pavana tanaya, sankat haram, mangala roopam—Rama, Lakshmana, Sita tho ma hrudayamlo undu.
verses.why_special_english: We ask Hanuman to stay with Rama in our hearts forever.

arrange_lines: पवनतनय संकट हरन, मंगल मूरति रूप।
राम लखन सीता सहित, हृदय बसहु सुर भूप॥।
